clusters.name: Your sister Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around your sister's birth in March 1995, within the following year: your mother was worn out and on edge with the baby by August, your parents were keeping distance by November with your father working late most nights, you had stomach aches and were missing school by February 1996, your brother Jonah and father had shouting matches by May, and your mother did not return to her job by September. The shifts pile up in sequence across the household, each touching a different person, and settle where your mother's functioning drops when she leaves work.
